main_text.head: ENARRATIO praeceptorum.
main_text.p: I. Recita decem praecepta Legis debito ordine.
main_text.head: Tabula prima.
main_text.p: Locutusq; est Dominus cunctos sermones hos. Ego sum dominus deus tuus, qui eduxi te de terra Ægypti, de domo servitutis. Non habebis deos alienos coram me.

Non facies tibi sculptile, neq; ullam similitudinem quae est in coelo desuper, et quae in terra deorsū, nec eorū quae sunt in aquis sub terra. Non adorabis ea, neq; coles ea. Ego enim sum dominus Deus tuus, Deus zelotes, visitas iniquitatem patrum in filios in tertiam et quartam generationem, eorum qui oderunt me, et faciens misericordiam in millia, his qui diligunt me & custodiunt praecepta mea.

page.notes: The scan shows faint show-through from the reverse side at the right margin and some pencil marks near the lower right and left edge, which are not transcribed. The superscript after "Locutusq;" is a small raised mark, read as the abbreviation for -que. "vanū" is uncertain: the final letters look like "vanq", read as vanū. The word at the foot right ("Ere") is faint and may be a catchword; it is marked [?]. The last line ends with a hyphen, and the word continues on the next page.
